```{r helper function}
library(ggplot2)

split_rows <- function(n, train_prop = 0.80, seed) {
  stopifnot(n >= 10L, train_prop > 0, train_prop < 1)
  set.seed(seed)
  train <- sort(sample.int(n, floor(train_prop * n), replace = FALSE))
  list(train = train, test = setdiff(seq_len(n), train))
}

fit_scaler <- function(x, tol = 1e-12) {
  x <- as.matrix(x)
  center <- colMeans(x)
  centered <- sweep(x, 2L, center, "-")
  scale <- sqrt(colMeans(centered^2))
  keep <- is.finite(scale) & scale > tol
  if (!any(keep)) stop("No nonconstant training predictor remains.")
  list(
    center = center[keep],
    scale = scale[keep],
    keep = keep,
    dropped = colnames(x)[!keep]
  )
}

apply_scaler <- function(x, prep) {
  x <- as.matrix(x)[, prep$keep, drop = FALSE]
  x <- sweep(x, 2L, prep$center, "-")
  sweep(x, 2L, prep$scale, "/")
}

make_foldid <- function(n, k = 5L, seed) {
  if (k < 3L || k > n) stop("Require 3 <= k <= number of training rows.")
  set.seed(seed)
  sample(rep(seq_len(k), length.out = n))
}

render_table <- function(df, caption, align = NULL) {
  if (is.null(align)) {
    align <- paste(rep("c", ncol(df)), collapse = "")
  }

  kbl(
    df,
    caption = caption,
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = align
  ) |>
    kable_styling(
      latex_options = c("hold_position", "striped"),
      position = "center",
      full_width = FALSE,
      font_size = 10
    ) |>
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
}

plot_histogram <- function(data, title, x_title, y_title) { 
  plot <- ggplot(
    data.frame(Value = data), 
    aes(x = Value)
  ) + 
    geom_histogram(
      bins = 20, 
      fill = "steelblue", 
      color = "white", 
      alpha = 0.8 
    ) + 
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = mean(data, na.rm = TRUE), 
      color = "blue", 
      linetype = "dashed", 
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) + 
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = median(data, na.rm = TRUE), 
      color = "darkgreen", 
      linetype = "dotted", 
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) + 
    labs(
      title = title, 
      x = x_title, 
      y = y_title
    ) + 
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + 
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5, 
        face = "bold"
      )
    ) 
  
  return(plot) 
}
```

```{r}
transform_data <- raw_data

transform_data$Cement <- sqrt(transform_data$Cement)
transform_data$BlastFurnaceSlag <- transform_data$BlastFurnaceSlag
transform_data$FlyAsh <- transform_data$FlyAsh 
transform_data$Water <- (transform_data$Water)^2
transform_data$Superplasticizer <- transform_data$Superplasticizer
transform_data$CoarseAggregate <- transform_data$CoarseAggregate
transform_data$FineAggregate <- transform_data$FineAggregate
transform_data$Age <- log(transform_data$Age)
transform_data$Strength <- sqrt(transform_data$Strength)

for (name in new_column_names){
  print(plot_histogram(transform_data[[name]], 
                       paste("Distribution of", name) ,
```

```{r data anova}

data(ToothGrowth)

ToothGrowth$supp <- factor(ToothGrowth$supp)
ToothGrowth$dose <- factor(ToothGrowth$dose)

model <- lm(len ~ supp * dose, data = ToothGrowth)
model_trans <- lm(log(len) ~ supp * dose, data = ToothGrowth)

qqnorm(residuals(model))
qqline(residuals(model))

qqnorm(residuals(model_trans))
qqline(residuals(model_trans))



plot(fitted(model_trans), residuals(model_trans),
     xlab = "Fitted values",
     ylab = "Residuals")

abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

plot(residuals(model_trans),
     type = "p",
     xlab = "Observation order",
     ylab = "Residual")

abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
```
